### Line 578

**Source:** [stdlib/geometry/planar.library.plato, line 578](../../../../../stdlib/geometry/planar.library.plato#L578).

```plato

    //==
    // # Local-frame and centred-bounds helpers
    //
    // The reduction the rotated planar shapes (Ellipse, SuperEllipse, OrientedBox2D,
    // RegularPolygon) all share: a conversion into the frame rotated by `Rotation` about
    // `Center`, its inverse, and the centred axis-aligned rectangle the bounds bodies
    // are written in terms of. Shared by every section of this library.

    //==
    // # Local-frame helpers
    //
    // The rotated shapes (Ellipse, SuperEllipse, OrientedBox2D, RegularPolygon)
    // all reduce to an axis-aligned test in a frame rotated by `Rotation` about
    // `Center`. These two conversions are the whole of that reduction.
    // https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Rotation_matrix

    // The displacement from `center` to `point`, expressed in the frame rotated by
    // `rotation`: the inverse rotation R(-rotation) applied to (point - center).
    LocalOffset(center: Point2D, rotation: Angle, point: Point2D): Vector2D
    {
        var v = center.Between(point);
        var c = rotation.Cos;
        var s = rotation.Sin;
        return (v.X * c + v.Y * s, v.Y * c - v.X * s);
    }
```
